name: run_ledger_partial_close_average_entry
description: Two buys establish an average entry, then a partial sell realizes PnL against that average; the remaining position keeps the same entry.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. AAA mult=1. FILL +2 @100 fee=0: entry=100, mark=100, wallet 1000, unrealized=0. FILL +2 @110 fee=0: increasing, entry=(2*100+2*110)/(2+2)=420/4=105; mark=110; wallet 1000; unrealized=4*1*(110-105)=4*5=20; equity=1020. FILL -1 @120 fee=0: reducing; closed_qty=1; sign(position)=+1; realized=(120-105)*1*1*(+1)=15; wallet=1000+15=1015; realized_cum=15; entry stays 105; mark=120 (fill price); remaining qty=3; unrealized=3*1*(120-105)=3*15=45; equity=1015+45=1060. Final: wallet 1015, unrealized 45, equity 1060, realized 15, fees 0, funding 0, position +3. Per-event equity processing order: [1000, 1020, 1060].
